nodes.title: Normalise the query once
nodes.why: Trimming and lower-casing in one place makes " SAN " and "san" the same query for the debounce, the cache and the ranking.
nodes.alternative: Normalise inside fetchSuggestions and in the cache lookup separately.
nodes.tradeoff: One normalisation at the entry keeps every later comparison consistent.

nodes.title: Cancel the pending work before every update
nodes.why: A new keystroke restarts the debounce window and marks any request in flight as stale, so the newest query is the only one that can reach the callback.
nodes.alternative: Keep every timer and compare timestamps when a response arrives.
nodes.tradeoff: Cancelling up front is simpler than ordering responses after the fact.

nodes.title: Answer a repeated query from the cache at once
nodes.why: A query the engine has already answered needs no debounce and no request; the cached list is emitted synchronously.
nodes.alternative: Always debounce and fetch, letting the network cache help.
nodes.tradeoff: The local cache saves the wait as well as the request, at the cost of a small eviction policy.

nodes.title: Debounce, then fetch with a request id
nodes.why: The request starts only after the wait, and the id taken when it starts identifies this request for the response handlers.
nodes.alternative: Fetch on every keystroke and throttle instead.
nodes.tradeoff: A debounce sends one request for the final query; throttling sends several and still has to order the responses.

nodes.title: Ignore a response that is not for the latest query
nodes.why: A slow response for an older query arrives after the newer results; comparing the request id and the latest query drops it before it touches the state.
nodes.alternative: Abort the older request with an AbortController.
nodes.tradeoff: Aborting saves bandwidth when the API supports it; the id check works with any promise.

nodes.title: Rank prefix matches first and drop duplicates
nodes.why: Suggestions that start with the query are what the user is typing; substring matches follow, each group alphabetical, and a Set drops repeats such as Ankara and ankara.
nodes.alternative: Return the API order and let the UI sort.
nodes.tradeoff: Ranking in the engine keeps every caller consistent and makes the cap deterministic.

nodes.title: Turn a rejection into an error state
nodes.why: A failed request becomes a state the UI can render and the next query clears, instead of an unhandled rejection that leaves the list stuck.
nodes.alternative: Let the rejection propagate to the caller.
nodes.tradeoff: One state shape for success and failure keeps the component that renders it simple.
